messages:
Eli: dropping a quick mock for a keyboard-driven version scrubber on the rollout history. goal: let engineers preview past states and prepare reverts without accidental applies. figma: figma.com/...
Maria: Nice. Primary concerns: discoverability of scrubber, SR order when jumping between versions, and clear affordance for 'preview' vs 'apply'.
Kai: For keyboard nav: Left/Right arrow move between snapshots, Shift+Left/Right jump by major versions, Enter opens details, 'r' starts revert flow. Esc cancels preview. Document sequence.
Aisha: Accessibility: when preview opens announce "Previewing snapshot YYYY-MM-DD, not live" with aria-live polite. Modal/dialog for apply must trap focus and include aria-describedby with typed-confirm instructions when required. Also make sure tab order in the details panel is logical.
Sam: Copy question: labels for revert action. PM suggested "Reinstate snapshot" vs "Revert to snapshot". I prefer "Revert to snapshot" for clarity in logs and audit. Keep a shorter label "Revert" in compact UI.
Eli: Good — we'll use short label in toolbar and long form in modal and audit. Also adding a small banner when previewing: "Previewing snapshot from Jun 8 — not live" with a bright icon.
Maria: Contrast check: banner must meet 4.5:1. On dark themes use solid background not semi-transparent. Also ensure icon has text fallback for colorblind users.
Aisha: Motion: respect prefers-reduced-motion. For timeline jumps use crossfade and avoid sweeping scroll which can be noisy for SR. When auto-scrolling to focused snapshot, do not reannounce entire timeline; announce only the focused snapshot.
Kai: Edge case: very dense histories with 100+ snapshots. Suggest virtualization + keyboard summary combobox (type to search commit message or tag). Also show a visible focus ring when snapshot is off-screen and auto-scroll to center it gently.
Sam: Revert safety: typed-confirm for prod namespaces and require an approvals toggle for large-scale reverts. Non-prod: modal + 10s undo toast. Toast should be keyboard-focusable and include op-id link to audit.
Eli: Action items: - implement keyboard map (arrows, Shift jump, r to start revert, Enter open) - preview banner with high contrast + aria-live - short/long copy pattern ("Revert" vs "Revert to snapshot") - typed-confirm for prod + approvals requirement for big reverts - undo toast in non-prod (10s) with op-id link + keyboard focusable - reduced-motion crossfade and SR-friendly announcements - virtualization + search combobox for long histories - update Figma and add keyboard doc.
designbot: Design review requested by Eli for `version-scrubber-keyboard`. Reviewers: Maria, Kai, Aisha, Sam. Deadline: 3 business days. :spiral_calendar:
Eli: thanks all, will push updated frames and the aria examples into the design tokens file. Ping when you review the keyboard doc.
